title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer - AWS - AI & Machine Learning - Fully Remote (UK) - Up to £110,000

Are you a Senior Data Engineer ready to take ownership of an entire data platform rather than simply contributing to one?

We're partnering with a rapidly growing technology business that develops innovative data-driven products for global enterprise clients. As part of significant investment in Data, Analytics and AI, they're looking for a Lead Data Engineer to take ownership of their cloud-based data platform and help shape the future direction of the company's analytics, machine learning and AI capabilities.

This is a unique opportunity to join at a pivotal stage of growth. Initially, you'll operate as a highly influential senior individual contributor with end-to-end ownership of the data function. As the business continues to scale, you'll have the opportunity to build and lead a dedicated Data Engineering team.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of the company's data platform and technical direction.
  • Play a key role in the company's Data, Analytics and AI strategy.
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science and Leadership teams.
  • Join a high-growth technology business at an exciting stage of expansion.
  • Build and lead a future Data Engineering function.
  • Enjoy a fully remote role with genuine flexibility and autonomy.

Technology Environment

You'll work across a modern cloud-based data ecosystem, including:

  • AWS
  • Python
  • SQL
  • Data Warehousing
  • Data Lakes
  • ETL/ELT Pipelines
  • APIs & Data Services
  • Analytics Engineering
  • Machine Learning Infrastructure
  • AI & Machine Learning Systems
  • Data Governance & Observability
  • Cloud-Native Architecture

The Role

As Lead Data Engineer, you'll be responsible for:

  • Designing, building and maintaining scalable cloud-based data platforms.
  • Developing robust ETL/ELT pipelines and data services.
  • Creating trusted analytical datasets to support reporting, business intelligence and advanced analytics.
  • Building APIs and data products used by enterprise clients.
  • Supporting Machine Learning and AI initiatives through high-quality data engineering and architecture.
  • Establishing data governance, quality, lineage and observability standards across the organisation.
  • Collaborating with technical and business stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Influencing the long-term data architecture, tooling and operating model of the business.

Essential Experience

We're looking for someone with:

  • Strong experience designing, building and operating production-grade data platforms.
  • Advanced SQL and data modelling expertise.
  • Hands-on AWS experience within modern cloud environments.
  • Experience developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • A track record of influencing technical direction and driving best practice.

Desirable Experience

Any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Experience supporting Machine Learning or AI workloads.
  • Exposure to MLOps, Agentic AI or AI-powered products.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar BI tools.
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, lineage and observability frameworks.
  • Experience working within fast-growth technology businesses or SaaS environments.

Benefits

  • Fully Remote Working (UK)
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Annual Team Bonus Scheme
  • Long-Term Incentive Opportunities
  • High Levels of Ownership and Autonomy
  • Clear Progression Path into Data Leadership
  • Opportunity to Build and Lead a Data Engineering Function

Interested? Apply now to learn more about this opportunity to shape and lead the future of Data, Analytics and AI within a growing technology business.
